motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves as the visitor reaches it. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The section is simply there when the visitor reaches it, which is the default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: The rows slide in and the figures count up from nought as the visitor reaches them. It needs the platform's behaviour library; where that is not served the section is simply still.
